chapter_title: Adolescence: A Stage of Growth and Change
core_summary: Adolescence is the developmental life stage between childhood and adulthood (roughly ages 10 to 19) characterized by rapid physical, physiological, and emotional growth leading to reproductive maturity. Growth spurts, voice deepens in boys (Adam's apple development), shoulders broaden, hips widen in girls, and secondary sexual characteristics develop driven by endocrine gland hormones. Menarche and menstrual cycle mark female reproductive maturation. Maintaining balanced nutrition (iron, calcium, protein), hygiene, physical exercise, and mental well-being are crucial during puberty.
key_concepts: To record and analyze growth velocity (height and weight changes) in adolescent boys and girls.

key_terms.definition: The period of transition from childhood to adulthood (ages 10-19) accompanied by physical and reproductive maturation.
